# Synthwave

A retro-future horizon with a restrained neon foreground.

## Use

Use for creative technology launches, game-like learning, and campaign heroes.

## Essential traits

- Retro horizon grid
- Pink-violet palette
- Clean readable panels

## Typography

Bold system sans-serif headings with monospace labels.

## Layout and surfaces

Horizon grid and sunset geometry behind a stable foreground. Deep violet, magenta outlines, and a warm stylized sun.

## Palette

- background: #180e32
- surface: #291b45
- text: #fff3ff
- muted: #d8bde7
- accent: #ffa9d9
- border: #956cad

## Copy-ready prompt

```text
Apply Synthwave to [DELIVERABLE] for [AUDIENCE]. Purpose: [GOAL]. Preserve all supplied content, existing visuals, and required brand constraints. Bold system sans-serif headings with monospace labels. Horizon grid and sunset geometry behind a stable foreground. Deep violet, magenta outlines, and a warm stylized sun. Palette: background #180e32, surface #291b45, text #fff3ff, muted #d8bde7, accent #ffa9d9, border #956cad. Essential traits: Retro horizon grid; Pink-violet palette; Clean readable panels. Avoid: Flashing neon; Overloaded gradients; Low-contrast purple text. Keep motion restrained and optional, respect reduced motion, and provide a static fallback. Adapt the appearance to the requested output format. Keep text legible, controls accessible, and content editable where supported. Resolve mandatory brand conflicts explicitly. Return the design and accurately report performed and unperformed checks.
```

## Validation

Available style specification. Check the actual output; no blanket accessibility or visual-fidelity certification is claimed.
